item.title: What will it take for U.S. and Iran to end war? Here’s what we know.
item.summary: The sides are far apart on Iran’s nuclear program, the Strait of Hormuz and the Israeli campaign against Hezbollah in Lebanon.

item.title: Trump announces naval blockade of Iran after Islamabad talks yield no deal
item.summary: The blockade could derail a tenuous ceasefire after just five days. Vice President JD Vance said the U.S. remains open to diplomacy if Iran takes “our final and best offer.”

item.title: Ceasefire means Netanyahu can’t keep promises, many Israelis say as elections loom
item.summary: Declaring victory now, for the second time in 10 months, makes it just a matter of time until a new round of fighting begins, some voters say, as the opposition sees an opening.

item.title: Direct U.S.-Iran talks fail to reach resolution after lengthy negotiation
item.summary: Vice President JD Vance was leading the highest level of face-to-face engagement between leaders of the United States and Iran in decades.

item.title: U.S., Iran prepare for peace talks with a gulf separating the two sides
item.summary: Amid allegations of bad faith and ceasefire violations from both Washington and Tehran, negotiators arrived in Islamabad for high-stakes talks.

item.title: Hungarian election tests Trump’s global reach as Orban fights for survival
item.summary: The president and vice president strongly backed Prime Minister Viktor Orban, a Kremlin ally and E.U. antagonist, but he trails in polls after 16 years in power.

item.title: On Africa trip, Pope Leo will face debate over polygamy as Catholicism booms
item.summary: Leo’s early papacy has been defined largely by his response to President Donald Trump but a 10-day trip, starting Monday, will let the pope focus on spreading the faith.

item.title: 10 years, 10 presidents. Peru’s leaders don’t last. Voters will try again.
item.summary: Elections on Sunday offer Peruvians another once-in-five-years chance to set the nation on a new path. All signs suggest they won’t.

item.title: Parrot goes on underwater adventure in his custom-built submarine
item.summary: “He enjoyed it,” said the owner of Bebe the parrot, who has also come along for skydiving, skiing and 500-mile bike rides.
